phase: Before question-only packet exposure; no authored answer indices, feedback, lesson guide or root/author answer tables received.
scope: Independently solve all12 stable-ID questions in the forthcoming original lesson Repeated evidence: two flags, three models. Source/content review only; no product run, source edit, mutation or deployment.
method: Read each question's model, class, flag/report semantics, queried event and conditioning event explicitly. Sum given joint cells; do not infer counts or independence not supplied.

For each answer record numerator, event-specific denominator and exact fraction before decimal/percentage approximation. Condition on an event using its count, not the whole-table total. Preserve given class priors; derive them from supplied class counts only when appropriate.

Within-class independence is checked from the class-conditioned joint table using exact equality of joint and product of marginals (or cross-products); marginal independence is separately checked after summing over classes. Neither implies the other without justification.
Never multiply flag/report likelihoods unless within-class independence for those events is justified by the supplied table/model. For dependent/copied reports use the actual joint event count.

A conditional probability is undefined when its conditioning event has zero total support. A zero likelihood in one class can still yield posterior0 when the overall conditioning denominator is positive; do not confuse these cases.

For exact copied reports, inconsistent flag pairs have zero support. Agreement may add no evidence after the first report. Repeated reports may inform less or differently than an independence shortcut suggests; compute the actual likelihood ratio/posterior rather than asserting a universal direction.
Keep probability of an event, conditional sensitivity/false-positive rate, and posterior class probability separate. State whether an independence conclusion is conditional or marginal.

Solve all12 before any key exposure. Review options for exactly one correct or defensibly equivalent answer, rounding ambiguity, missing undefined choice, mistaken denominators, unsupported independence and ambiguous report semantics.
Record derivations and content/distractor findings with stable IDs. Any necessary correction is a documented review finding; do not silently rewrite the author's question or consult its key.

receivingBoundary.allowed: Question-only packet containing tables, prompts, stable IDs, choices and transfer tasks.
receivingBoundary.execution: No native/probe/source-memory baseline or runtime invocation.
